full_name: Javier Zamora | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Fiction & Poetry Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Stanford University
bio: Javier Zamora is a Salvadoran American poet and activist. His debut work explores borderland politics and race and the ways in which immigration and the civil war have impacted his family.
